formula: (sigmoid(2 * (- safe_div(numerator=2 * close - high - low, denominator=high - low) * safe_div(numerator=ts_mean(high - low, 5), denominator=ts_mean(close, 5)))) * 2 - 1)
rationale: Preserve strong IC and RankIC from parent crossover_vcmi_1 (volume-confirmed momentum gated by intraday position). Borrow tanh nonlinearity from parent crossover_liquidity_tanh_reversal_001 to compress extreme outlier values, improving MI and rank stability without altering the core momentum mechanism.
filter: volume > 0 AND not is_suspend AND close < high_limit AND close > low_limit
